messages:
alex: FYI — edge sample app using @redwood/inference-edge@0.13.0 fails during import in Deno Deploy with `Unexpected token` on the first line. quick local inspect of the tarball shows a mismatch between exports and files.

rina: which mismatch exactly? cjs vs esm?

alex: package.json exports point to `./dist/index.mjs` for import, but dist only has `index.cjs` and `index.cjs.map`. plus the `.map` inside the cjs file references `index.cjs.map` but our edge import tries to load the `.mjs` path and dies before map lookup. no `index.mjs` and no `index.d.ts`.

ci-bot: publish manifest for 0.13.0:
- dist/index.cjs
- dist/index.cjs.map
- package.json
- LICENSE
( missing: dist/index.mjs, dist/index.d.ts, dist/index.mjs.map )

alex: reproducer: `import { client } from '@redwood/inference-edge'` in Deno -> `Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'`. Edge runtimes expect native es modules.

rina: sounds like a build config change. Did someone switch tsup/rollup to single-format output?

alex: yeah a recent commit set `formats: ['cjs']` to speed bundles. it shipped accidentally.

sre-oncall: customer reported this in the enterprise slack. it's blocking a PoC. we should hotfix.

r ina: (typo) re: hotfix — quick plan: 1) republish patch 0.13.1 with both esm+cjs outputs and types, 2) add GH Action `artifact-verify` to the release workflow to assert that: exports.import file exists, types path exists, and source maps referenced in files exist in the package.

alex: can we also add an integration smoke test that runs `node --input-type=module` or Deno import of the packed tarball? that would catch edge-only failures.

ci-bot: suggestion: add `pack-check` step that unpacks `npm pack` output and validates `exports` targets and that `//# sourceMappingURL=` targets exist in the archive. Return non-zero exit code if mismatch.

rina: good. also add a lint rule in the repo that flags `formats: ['cjs']` in the build config for edge-targeted packages, or require an explicit comment `// intentionally cjs-only` to avoid accidental changes.

sre-oncall: Sentry showed sourcemap resolution failures earlier because `.map` filenames differed between builds (`index.mjs.map` vs `index.cjs.map`) and our release notes didn't include a breaking change. can we normalize map naming so both formats include maps with consistent suffixes?

alex: agree. plan: produce `index.mjs`, `index.mjs.map`, `index.cjs`, `index.cjs.map`, and a `types/index.d.ts` entry. update package.json `types` to point to `types/index.d.ts`. also patch the sourceMappingURL comment to reference the exact filename.

r ina: I'll open the PR with the build revert + `artifact-verify` action + pack smoke tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/410 (edge publish fixes). tagging @alex for review.

ci-bot: release workflow note — current publish job runs `npm publish` without artifact verification. will add gating step so publish fails if `artifact-verify` fails.

sre-oncall: please communicate to support so they can tell affected customers the ETA for the patch. also add a postmortem note to the release runbook.

alex: thanks. after patch and republish, I'll test sample apps across Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, and Netlify Edge to confirm imports succeed.

r ina: assigning follow-up ticket: `DEVEX-582: add pack-check + edge-smoke to release CI` and `DEVEX-583: enforce map naming parity`. leaving comments on the PR. :+1:
